jobs.title: AI Director - Global AI Risk Management
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 279160
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  

Leads and oversees a team within the Data \& AI Risk (DAIR), GRM group ensuring the Enterprise Artificial Intelligence (AI) Risk strategies, implementation program and mandated activities are executed / delivered in compliance with the governing regulations, internal policies and procedures, and in support of innovation and business strategy.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**


* Lead and drive a customer focused culture throughout their team to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems and knowledge to execute the AI Risk Management Program.
* Support the VP, Data \& AI Risk in shaping and executing the Enterprise AI Risk strategies.
* Design and implement the AI Risk Program including management of AI Risk Management policies, procedures, metrics and processes.
* Establish and lead the independent second\-line AI risk management oversight and challenge function to support identification, assessment, monitoring and escalations of AI risk in collaboration with other risk partners.
* Lead the roll\-out and ongoing execution of the AI Risk Management Program among business lines/corporate offices and geographies, which includes but is not limited to the following:
	+ Develop, refine, and enhance the assigned AI risk framework components, policies, procedures, processes, tools, and metrics with the objective to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of the AI risk.
	+ Ensure AI Risk Management policy enforcement and compliance through appropriate governance and oversight mechanisms.
	+ Establish and lead the execution of the 2nd line risk oversight, effective challenge, risk measurement and reporting (NIRAs, RCSA, internal management reports, senior management, and/or Board reports), including identification and escalation of material and emerging risks.
	+ Advise and collaborate with first line business lines, corporate functions, key stakeholders with regards to the AI risk management principles, standards, controls, and best practices, while maintaining effective second\-line independence and challenge.
	+ Partner with AI Governance and Model Risk Management functions, Technology, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Compliance and other key partners with identification, communication and reporting of relevant AI risk priorities, successes, issues, dependencies and regulatory expectations.
	+ Guide and influence various stakeholders across the organization to achieve the goals defined in the DAIR and AI Risk Management strategies and programs, including the responsible adoption of emerging AI technologies.
	+ Support resolution of risk governance and management issues by driving coordination, alignment and timely escalation where required.
	+ Lead AI risk awareness events and training sessions on AI risk management framework, policy, 2nd line of defense processes, metrics and reporting.
* Provide oversight on the prioritization and remediation plans for AI risk\-related issues: measure, report and monitor key AI risk indicators, identify compliance gaps and risk issues, guide risk impact\-focused gap and issue prioritization and creation of action plans to remediate gaps and issues, monitor plan execution, and escalate material or overdue issues in accordance with the Bank's risk governance framework.
* Monitor relevant global regulatory developments and assess their potential implications for the Bank's AI risk management framework, controls and risk posture.
* Ensure that own and team’s day\-to\-day activities are conducted in a manner consistent with the Bank’s risk culture and the relevant risk appetite statement and limits. Communicate the Bank’s risk culture and risk appetite statement throughout his/her team.
* Develop or contribute to ad\-hoc reporting to the Board, risk committees, and senior leadership, including the collection of metrics and reports
* Act as a thought leader in AI risk governance, representing the organization in various industry forums and panels
* Create an environment in which the team pursues effective and efficient operations within respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct, and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day\-to\-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.
* Build a high\-performance environment and implement a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviours; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? \- We'd love to work with you if you have:**


* Minimum 7 years of relevant progressive experience in compliance, risk management, legal or analytics, model or AI governance.
* Deep understanding of AI technologies, ML/AI risk management best practices, relevant global laws, regulations, and ethical and risk management standards.
* Strong grasp of global and regional AI regulations.
* Curious and proactive and agile learner interested in new technology, ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic risk management best practices, trends and developments in data and AI governance.
* Experience in leading the development of policies, risk assessments and conducting training programs to establish effective AI risk oversight practice with defined success measures.
* Very strong organizational, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated experience and skills in collaboration, teamwork, and problem\-solving to achieve strategic objectives.
* Demonstrated ability to spark innovation and act as a trusted advisor to help teams use AI responsibly.

jobs.title: VP, GWAM Technology Operations & Platforms
jobs.description:
* Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, GWAM Technology, and as a member of the GWAM Technology Leadership Team, you will work closely with business and technology executives to align platform investments and operational priorities with enterprise goals, customer outcomes, regulatory requirements and business growth objectives.
* This leader will be accountable for the reliability, resilience, security and continuous modernization of the technology platforms that support GWAM's business strategy and digital ambitions.
* You will lead a diverse portfolio spanning platform engineering, production operations, cloud platform services, automation, AI enablement and technology infrastructure. A central part of the mandate is to move traditional infrastructure and operations toward a modern platform engineering model built on automation, self service capabilities, developer enablement, operational resilience and AI powered operations.
* This leader will consolidate platforms and platform engineering across GWAM Technology. The priority is to modernize the infrastructure environment, drive greater automation and AI enablement, improve operational efficiency, and establish stronger accountability for services and costs.
  

  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  

* Set and deliver the strategic roadmap for GWAM Platforms and IT Operations, including governance, prioritization, capacity planning and investment management
* Advance a product oriented platform engineering operating model that improves automation, accountability, transparency and delivery effectiveness.
* Advance cloud capabilities that support the organization's agentic AI ambitions.
* Provide leadership and direction to the existing AVP and broader teams.
* Strengthen oversight of GTCS, setting clear expectations around service levels, cost transparency and delivery on behalf of all of GWAM IT.
* Ensure the availability, performance and resilience of critical platforms by leading incident reduction, problem management, disaster recovery and operational readiness
* Deliver modern, self service platform capabilities that accelerate application delivery and improve developer productivity.
* Develop and execute the platform strategy for AI enabled IT operations and engineering, with clear governance and controls for responsible adoption
* Maintain strong security and operational controls aligned with Manulife's risk, cybersecurity, audit and regulatory requirements, and champion secure by design engineering practices.
* Partner with application, architecture and business teams to prioritize platform investments and provide executive oversight of major transformations, migrations and integrations
* Own the operating budget, workforce plan and investment portfolio, including transparent, consumption based allocation models and accountability for strategic vendors and shared service providers.
* Build and lead a high performing, inclusive and diverse organization with strong succession plans and leadership bench strength.
  

  

**Leadership Profile:**

  

  

* You are a strategic and pragmatic technology leader who creates a compelling vision for platforms and turns it into disciplined execution. You balance technology investment with business value, customer outcomes, risk and financial stewardship.
* You lead large scale change with confidence, build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and bring a solution focused, intrapreneurial mindset to working across shared services and business functions. You develop leaders, create accountability and build the conditions for talented teams to do their best work.
  

  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Management Information Systems, Technology, Business or an equivalent discipline. A graduate degree and additional language capability are considered assets
* 10\+ years of hands on technology leadership experience, including at least 8 years in software engineering, with a track record of developing and executing strategic and tactical plans
* Should understand how to modernize infrastructure through automation, AI and engineering practices.
* Demonstrated experience leading large scale technology operations, platform engineering, cloud, infrastructure, application engineering or shared technology services
* Proven success leading complex transformation and modernization programs across multiple technical teams and business functions in a large, global, matrixed environment
* Experience managing significant operational budgets, workforce plans, vendors and technology investment portfolios
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure preferred), platform engineering, automation, site reliability engineering, security, operational resilience, Agile delivery, DevOps and AI enabled operations.
* Demonstrated success building high performing leadership teams, developing technical talent and strengthening organizational capability
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex technology topics clearly to executive, business and technical audiences.
  

  

**Additional Information:**

  

  

* This role follows a hybrid working arrangement, combining time in the office with remote work. The role will involve regular interaction with senior business and technology executives, enterprise technology partners, information security and risk functions, auditors, finance and procurement partners, and strategic vendors across multiple geographies and time zones. Some travel may be required.
  

  

***When you join our team:***

  

  

* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well\-being and inclusion are more than just words.
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

BMO Capital Markets is a leading, full\-service financial services provider. We offer corporate and investment banking, treasury management, as well as research and advisory services to clients around the world. \#bmocapitalmarkets


**Mandate:**

  

**We are looking for an individual who has built out a metrics and reporting program for a client onboarding function that enabled removing bottlenecks and unlocking revenue.**

The Client Enablement team is responsible for onboarding new clients and enabling them to successfully transact quickly and accurately, with high\-touch service both internally and externally. The Client onboarding process encompasses Intake, Regulatory/Jurisdictional/Product Approval Compliance, Trade Reporting Compliance, Credit Line Setup, Legal Agreement (e.g. ISDA) Negotiation, Account Opening, and Electronic Setups. The group fulfills key governance requirements and plays a central role in how quickly and effectively clients are onboarded and enabled to transact with BMO Capital Markets.  



Reporting to the Managing Director \& Head of Client Onboarding, Client Tax Governance, and Client Operations, the Director is a senior leader who will build and lead the onboarding analytics and reporting agenda for Capital Markets, bringing a proven track record of turning operational data into commercial insight in this space. The role links client onboarding and client enablement processes to revenue, connecting onboarding milestones such as KYC, legal documentation, credit, and account set\-up to client activation and revenue outcomes, and delivers the insights needed to speed up and improve the end\-to\-end client experience. The role will also report on selected cross sell analytics. The Data and Analytics team aggregates data from across Capital Markets systems into outcome\-driven visualizations and reporting that drive insights, enable day\-to\-day evidence\-based decision making, and support targeting for increased revenue generation.  



This role will:


* Working with senior leadership, set the vision and roadmap for onboarding and client enablement analytics, defining the metrics, KPIs, and reporting that matter most to senior business and operations leaders.
* Provide hands\-on leadership of a small team as people manager while building reports.
* Link onboarding and client enablement processes to revenue, quantifying the commercial impact of cycle time, bottlenecks, and backlog on client activation and revenue realization.
* Deliver insights that accelerate onboarding, reduce friction for clients and Front Office partners, and prioritize process, data, and technology improvements.
* Lead stakeholder engagement with senior leaders across Front Office, Operations, AML/KYC, Legal, and Technology, translating business questions into automated reporting and data visualizations.
Provide data analytics, data governance, and data tools and technology leadership that will support Capital Markets, Client Enablement, and strategic transformation initiatives.  
* 

  

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Lead the onboarding analytics and reporting strategy, establishing an end\-to\-end view of the client onboarding and client enablement lifecycle from client request through account activation.
* Build and maintain an onboarding\-to\-revenue framework that links onboarding milestones (KYC, legal documentation, credit, and new accounts) to client activation, trading activity, and revenue.
* Define, capture, measure, and report KPIs and SLAs (e.g., cycle time, aging, backlog, throughput, and first\-time\-right) that support defined business objectives.
* Deliver executive\-ready dashboards and data visualizations that provide actionable insights to senior business partners and governance forums.
* Use data to identify bottlenecks, root causes, and improvement opportunities, and recommend solutions that speed up and improve onboarding and the client experience.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to lead requirements gathering, with a focus on delivering desired business outcomes.
* Provide subject matter and technical leadership in data profiling and analysis that supports Client Data Strategy and enterprise initiatives.
* Champion data governance so that data is fit for purpose and meets business, usability, and data quality requirements and standards.
* Drive the maturation of operational process efficiencies using automation, AI, and technology.
* Mentor and develop analytics talent, fostering a culture of curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Ensure adherence to BMO privacy and confidentiality requirements (legal, compliance and operational risk).  
* 

  

**Authorities:**

* Accountable for the onboarding analytics and reporting roadmap, including prioritization of reporting and insight requests.
* Accountable for defining and governing onboarding KPIs, metric definitions, and the onboarding\-to\-revenue methodology.
* Responsible for providing insightful data visualizations and executive reporting.
* Responsible for BAU oversight; ensuring reports are built and breaks/issues with existing reports and/or processes are addressed in a timely manner.
Make recommendations on, and lead implementation of, process automations and improvements.  
* 

  

**Scope \& Impact:**

This role has direct or indirect impact on the following:


* Client Onboarding
* AML/KYC
* New Accounts
* Legal
* Tax Operations
* Front Office groups
* Client Enablement and client experience
Data Governance

**Work at CBC/Radio\-Canada**


At CBC/Radio\-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.
  

  

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever\-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

**Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next\-generation public service media organization.**

The Technology \& Infrastructure (T\&I) team is the backbone and the future\-forward arm of CBC/Radio\-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technologies and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

  



A place with purpose. CBC/Radio\-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

**This is a hybrid role with a mix of in\-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.**

  



**Role Vision and Impact**

The Senior Director, Information Security and End\-User Technology, serves as CBC/Radio\-Canada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). A strategic, visionary and collaborative leader, the CISO defines, implements and drives the overarching vision for cybersecurity, risk management and technological resilience across all corporate environments.

  



The mission of this strategic role is to **protect information assets, data, digital heritage, and production and broadcasting infrastructure across all platforms, while ensuring seamless, agile and uninterrupted media operations.** The Senior Director optimally balances rigorous security architecture governance with the flexibility that creative, journalistic and technical teams need to innovate and broadcast without disruption.

  



Operating at a senior executive level, the CISO regularly briefs and advises the **Board of Directors (BoD),** the **Audit Committee,** the **CBC/Radio\-Canada Senior Executive Team (SET)** and the **T\&I Management Executive Team (MET).**

  



Supported by a team of experienced directors and senior managers overseeing governance, security operations, end\-user technology and identity management, the Senior Director serves as the cornerstone of digital trust and strategic transformation for Canada’s public broadcaster.

**Strategic Vision, Leadership and Executive Relations**


* Develop, champion and execute an enterprise\-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with the Corporation’s business mission, risk profile and digital transformation.
* Serve as a trusted expert and strategic adviser to the BoD, Audit Committee, SET and MET regarding risk status, security posture and maturity, and required investments.
* Foster a “Security by Design” culture and establish security architecture governance frameworks that keep operational and production workflows running smoothly while proactively managing risk.
* Anticipate technology trends and lead the secure integration of artificial intelligence (AI/GenAI) and automation into business processes and security defences across the organization.

  

**Securing IT, Cloud, Distribution and** **Broadcast/Operational** **Technology (OT) Environments**


* Define and continuously adapt the security strategy across the entire technology landscape, including corporate IT infrastructure, cloud systems, end\-user environments, and critical production, broadcast and network infrastructure.
* Ensure the resilience of content acquisition, processing and distribution workflows against threats targeting the media sector and critical infrastructure.

* Oversee the governance function responsible for developing, maintaining and enforcing policies, standards, security architecture principles, exception management and industry frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, AI frameworks).
* Lead the third\-party and partner risk management program (covering vendors and technology contracts) in close collaboration with the Legal Services and Procurement teams.

**Description**
---------------


The Senior Director, Governance \& Execution Oversight, Global Risk Intelligence and Technology (GRIT) is responsible for driving execution discipline, governance effectiveness, adoption management, and value realization across Global Risk transformation initiatives in AI, Data and Technology. The role serves as a key partner in Global Risk Technology and Intelligence governance, translating strategic priorities into executable workstreams while ensuring governance decisions result in measurable business outcomes.

  

  

This position will oversee intake and prioritization processes, establish operating frameworks and governance disciplines, and define the metrics and reporting needed to measure adoption, benefits realization, capacity utilization, and portfolio performance.

  

  

The role acts as a critical link between strategy, governance, execution, and sustained business value realization across the Global Risk portfolio.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**


**Transformation Governance \& Strategic Execution**
----------------------------------------------------


* Partner with senior leaders to translate approved priorities into executable workstream plans.
* Establish and maintain governance processes supporting prioritization, intake, qualification, approval, and execution oversight.
* Drive accountability and follow\-through on decisions arising from governance forums.
* Coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment of delivery plans, dependencies, milestones, and outcomes.

**Operating Model \& Process Excellence**

* Develop and maintain RASCIs, Standard Operating Procedures, playbooks, operating frameworks, qualification frameworks, intake processes, and governance documentation.

jobs.description:
CONTEXT
  
At Make\-A\-Wish® Canada, we’re redefining how the world perceives wishes through our transformative new brand platform: Wishes Are Medicine. Grounded in research, this platform recognizes what we’ve long known to be true — that wishes have measurable healing power. When prescribed alongside medical treatment, wishes reduce stress, elevate endorphins, limit emergency room visits, and deliver lasting health benefits.
  
With more than 3,500 children still waiting and a new child diagnosed with a critical illness in Canada every two hours, our mission has never been more urgent — and there are many more prescriptions to fill.
  
To meet this challenge, we’ve launched our new three\-year strategic plan — Wishes Are Medicine: One Team, One Mission — focused intentionally on financial sustainability, mission impact, and operational excellence. When a child is facing a critical illness, a wish isn’t just a moment of joy — it’s a medically supported turning point. Studies show that children who receive a wish are 2\.5 times less likely to have unplanned hospital visits and 1\.9 times less likely to need the ER, with 100% of physicians agreeing that a wish can be a pivotal moment in treatment.
  
At Make\-A\-Wish Canada, you can play a lead role in bringing these powerful prescriptions to life. Where Wishes Are Medicine, transformation becomes a pathway to healing at scale — and this role is your opportunity to architect that future.
  
Our ambition to reach more children and families requires a strong financial and operational foundation. As Vice President, Finance \& Business Operations, you will help shape that foundation, bringing strategic leadership to financial planning, investments, risk, governance and the services that enable our organization to thrive. You will turn insight into action, strengthen how resources are invested and managed, and help build a more resilient, disciplined and mission\-driven organization.
  
At Make\-A\-Wish Canada, you’ll join a team united by a shared mission and an unwavering sense of possibility. Every role — whether advancing fundraising, brand, operations, or technology — helps fuel the same trajectory: transforming how hope and healing come to life for children and families nationwide. If you’re ready to help build a future where every eligible child receives the wish that helps them heal, we invite you to read on.
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We’re seeking a Vice President, Finance \& Business Operations, a strategic and forward\-thinking leader who will help shape the next chapter of Make\-A\-Wish Canada. This is more than a finance role; it’s an opportunity to strengthen the financial and operational foundation that will enable our mission to grow sustainably.
  
As a key member of our Senior Leadership Team, and reporting to the Senior Vice President, Transformation \& Operations, you will bring together financial strategy, business operations, analytics, risk and governance to strengthen how we plan, invest and make decisions. You’ll provide the insight and discipline to steward our resources responsibly, improve organizational performance, and build the capabilities needed to support sustainable growth and greater mission impact.
  
If you bring financial acumen, business curiosity and enterprise thinking, and believe the strongest organizations pair ambition with discipline, this is your opportunity to help build the foundation from which our mission can grow and bring the power of Wishes Are Medicine to more children and families across Canada.

**Shape Financial Strategy:** Lead budgeting, forecasting, multi\-year financial planning, and financial modelling. Translate insights into scenarios and recommendations that guide sustainable, mission\-aligned decisions over a three\-to\-five\-year time horizon.
  
**Steward Assets and Investments:** Oversee financial assets, treasury, and investment portfolio performance in accordance with policy, ensuring disciplined stewardship and informed decision\-making.
  
**Strengthen Governance and Reporting:** Provide clear financial reporting to the Board of Directors and Senior Leadership Team, support the Finance \& Audit Committee, and ensure sound governance, audit readiness, and compliance with CRA and other regulatory obligations.
  
**Advance Enterprise Risk Management:** Maintain the enterprise risk register, strengthen internal controls, and lead business continuity and disaster recovery planning to protect the organization’s assets, reputation, and long\-term sustainability.
  
**Modernize Financial Capability:** Build stronger modelling, analytics, systems, and processes that improve forecasting, performance visibility, operational efficiency, and organizational decision\-making.
  
**Lead Business Services:** Oversee property management, leases, contracts, insurance, and related business services. Balance operational efficiency and financial sustainability with investments in organizational capability and a safe, supportive workplace.
  
**Oversee Gift and Donation Administration:** Ensure sound systems and processes for restricted giving, endowments, estates, and other complex giving structures, coordinating closely with development teams to support stewardship and compliance.
  
**Advise and Partner:** Serve as a trusted advisor to the Senior Vice President, Transformation \& Operations, the CEO, and leadership colleagues on finance, risk, and business operations. Bring an enterprise lens to strategic planning and execution.
  
**Guide and Develop Talent:** Build, coach, and lead a high\-performing Finance and Business Operations team, creating clarity, accountability, collaboration, and opportunities for growth.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

At Samee Metal Trading, we are moving beyond traditional historical reporting to build a forward\-looking financial engine. We are seeking a battle\-tested **Chief Financial Officer (CFO)**—an operational leader who thrives in complexity, operates with high urgency, and balances hands\-on execution with strategic clarity.

This is a **"build, fix, and scale"** mandate for a leader ready to serve as both the guardian of capital and a catalyst for performance across a multi\-entity, multi\-division platform spanning trading, industrial storage, and logistics. Working directly alongside the President/CEO, you will modernize our financial infrastructure, unlock capital from our asset base, drive margin expansion, and compound enterprise value over the long term.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Liquidity, Treasury \& Lender Relations:** Establish absolute daily and weekly cash visibility alongside rigorous 13\-week cash flow forecasting. Drive aggressive working capital optimization, structure operating lines and asset\-backed financing, lead banking/lender negotiations, and ensure strict covenant compliance.
* **Profitability Turnaround \& Operational Reporting:** Take full P\&L ownership with direct accountability for margin expansion. Transition reporting out of manual spreadsheets by configuring our ERP/accounting systems to produce real\-time KPI dashboards and automated division\- and unit\-level P\&Ls (including fleet, asset, and property\-level performance).
* **Strategic Partnership \& Capital Allocation:** Partner directly with the President on high\-value commercial pricing, deal structuring, capital expenditure analysis, and commercial real estate finance (acquisition financing, rent rolls, and leasehold accounting).
* **Team Leadership \& Finance Transformation:** Rebuild, mentor, and scale the internal accounting and finance team—defining clear roles, writing SOPs, installing internal controls, and coaching technical accounting/controller talent into effective people managers.
* **Governance, Tax \& Compliance:** Oversee FP\&A, Accounting, Tax, and Treasury across all entities. Ensure bulletproof compliance with US GAAP and North American statutory requirements, managing Canadian corporate tax, Capital Cost Allowance (CCA), sales/payroll tax, and coordinating complex tax planning with external counsel.
* **Executive Discretion \& Shareholder Support:** Operate with the highest level of confidentiality and maturity inside a sole\-shareholder, family\-owned enterprise—engaging thoughtfully with the shareholder’s broader financial picture and taking ownership of high\-end, ad\-hoc financial deliverables that belong at the CFO’s desk.

**What You Bring**

**Credentials \& Leadership Track Record**

* **Education \& Designation:** Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting, paired with a **Canadian CPA designation in good standing** (or equivalent senior accounting credential). An MBA is an asset.
* **Executive Experience:** 5\+ years of progressive, hands\-on CFO or senior finance leadership experience in turnarounds, high\-growth, or cash\-intensive environments.
* **Proven Value Creation:** A demonstrable track record of generating measurable financial returns—through tax optimization, financing wins, working capital improvements, or margin expansion—that materially exceed the cost of the finance function.
* **Industry Context:** Multi\-division experience across commodity trading, steel, supply chain, transportation/logistics, industrial operations, or commercial real estate is strongly preferred.

**Technical \& Systems Mastery**

* **Accounting \& Tax Command:** Expert\-level command of US GAAP, complex debt/equity structures, working capital cycles, and Canadian corporate tax/CCA regulations.
* **Hands\-On ERP Optimization:** Deep capability with modern accounting and ERP platforms—able to personally configure, optimize, and train staff on the system rather than relying on external consultants.
* **Team Builder \& Coach:** Proven success establishing financial controls from the ground up, writing SOPs, and developing staff who stay and grow with the business.

**Mindset \& Cultural Fit**

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance & Business Operations
jobs.description:
CONTEXT
  
At Make\-A\-Wish® Canada, we’re redefining how the world perceives wishes through our transformative new brand platform: Wishes Are Medicine. Grounded in research, this platform recognizes what we’ve long known to be true — that wishes have measurable healing power. When prescribed alongside medical treatment, wishes reduce stress, elevate endorphins, limit emergency room visits, and deliver lasting health benefits.
  
With more than 3,500 children still waiting and a new child diagnosed with a critical illness in Canada every two hours, our mission has never been more urgent — and there are many more prescriptions to fill.
  
To meet this challenge, we’ve launched our new three\-year strategic plan — Wishes Are Medicine: One Team, One Mission — focused intentionally on financial sustainability, mission impact, and operational excellence. When a child is facing a critical illness, a wish isn’t just a moment of joy — it’s a medically supported turning point. Studies show that children who receive a wish are 2\.5 times less likely to have unplanned hospital visits and 1\.9 times less likely to need the ER, with 100% of physicians agreeing that a wish can be a pivotal moment in treatment.
  
At Make\-A\-Wish Canada, you can play a lead role in bringing these powerful prescriptions to life. Where Wishes Are Medicine, transformation becomes a pathway to healing at scale — and this role is your opportunity to architect that future.
  
Our ambition to reach more children and families requires a strong financial and operational foundation. As Vice President, Finance \& Business Operations, you will help shape that foundation, bringing strategic leadership to financial planning, investments, risk, governance and the services that enable our organization to thrive. You will turn insight into action, strengthen how resources are invested and managed, and help build a more resilient, disciplined and mission\-driven organization.
  
At Make\-A\-Wish Canada, you’ll join a team united by a shared mission and an unwavering sense of possibility. Every role — whether advancing fundraising, brand, operations, or technology — helps fuel the same trajectory: transforming how hope and healing come to life for children and families nationwide. If you’re ready to help build a future where every eligible child receives the wish that helps them heal, we invite you to read on.
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We’re seeking a Vice President, Finance \& Business Operations, a strategic and forward\-thinking leader who will help shape the next chapter of Make\-A\-Wish Canada. This is more than a finance role; it’s an opportunity to strengthen the financial and operational foundation that will enable our mission to grow sustainably.
  
As a key member of our Senior Leadership Team, and reporting to the Senior Vice President, Transformation \& Operations, you will bring together financial strategy, business operations, analytics, risk and governance to strengthen how we plan, invest and make decisions. You’ll provide the insight and discipline to steward our resources responsibly, improve organizational performance, and build the capabilities needed to support sustainable growth and greater mission impact.
  
If you bring financial acumen, business curiosity and enterprise thinking, and believe the strongest organizations pair ambition with discipline, this is your opportunity to help build the foundation from which our mission can grow and bring the power of Wishes Are Medicine to more children and families across Canada.
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
**Shape Financial Strategy:** Lead budgeting, forecasting, multi\-year financial planning, and financial modelling. Translate insights into scenarios and recommendations that guide sustainable, mission\-aligned decisions over a three\-to\-five\-year time horizon.
  
**Steward Assets and Investments:** Oversee financial assets, treasury, and investment portfolio performance in accordance with policy, ensuring disciplined stewardship and informed decision\-making.
  
**Strengthen Governance and Reporting:** Provide clear financial reporting to the Board of Directors and Senior Leadership Team, support the Finance \& Audit Committee, and ensure sound governance, audit readiness, and compliance with CRA and other regulatory obligations.
  
**Advance Enterprise Risk Management:** Maintain the enterprise risk register, strengthen internal controls, and lead business continuity and disaster recovery planning to protect the organization’s assets, reputation, and long\-term sustainability.
  
**Modernize Financial Capability:** Build stronger modelling, analytics, systems, and processes that improve forecasting, performance visibility, operational efficiency, and organizational decision\-making.
  
**Lead Business Services:** Oversee property management, leases, contracts, insurance, and related business services. Balance operational efficiency and financial sustainability with investments in organizational capability and a safe, supportive workplace.
  
**Oversee Gift and Donation Administration:** Ensure sound systems and processes for restricted giving, endowments, estates, and other complex giving structures, coordinating closely with development teams to support stewardship and compliance.
  
**Advise and Partner:** Serve as a trusted advisor to the Senior Vice President, Transformation \& Operations, the CEO, and leadership colleagues on finance, risk, and business operations. Bring an enterprise lens to strategic planning and execution.
  
**Guide and Develop Talent:** Build, coach, and lead a high\-performing Finance and Business Operations team, creating clarity, accountability, collaboration, and opportunities for growth.

Established in 1937, Marquis, a division of Lakeside Book Company, offers integrated print and logistics solutions to thousands of content owners in Canada, the United States, and Europe. Today, our team includes more than 600 employees in six business locations across Canada: Montmagny, Quebec City, Louiseville, Sherbrooke, Georgetown, and Toronto. Marquis is at the heart of our industry's action due to the company's mastery of new technologies, sense of innovation, and privileged relationships with our customers.
  
  

**Salary:** Starting $150/hour
  
  

**JOB SUMMARY:**  

The Finance Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational financial leadership for Marquis Book Printing Inc., overseeing the accounting and financial planning and analysis (FP\&A) functions. The role ensures the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial information while translating financial and operational results into insights that support business performance, investment decisions, and long\-term growth. Based in Canada, the Finance Director leads the Marquis finance team and partners closely with Lakeside Book Company’s U.S. Corporate Finance organization to support consolidated reporting, planning, financial governance, and cross\-border business initiatives.
  
  

**KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Provide overall leadership and direction for Marquis Finance, establishing priorities, financial objectives, and operating practices that support business strategy and performance.
* Lead and develop the Accounting Manager, FP\&A Manager, and Credit Supervisor, setting clear expectations, strengthening capabilities, and ensuring effective coordination across accounting, reporting, planning, and analysis.
* Oversee the integrity and timeliness of Marquis financial reporting, close, consolidation, intercompany accounting, and financial controls through the Accounting Manager; ensure significant accounting matters and risks are appropriately escalated and resolved.
* Provide executive oversight of financial planning and analysis, including annual budgets, periodic forecasts, long\-range plans, financial models, KPI reporting, profitability analysis, and business cases through the FP\&A Manager.
* Provide financial oversight and strategic support to the Credit function, partnering with the Credit Supervisor to monitor accounts receivable performance, customer credit risk, collections effectiveness, and working capital. Support the development of policies, processes, and strategies that strengthen credit management and minimize financial exposure.
* Partner with Marquis and Lakeside Book leadership to evaluate financial performance, identify risks and opportunities, assess strategic investments and capital projects, and recommend actions to improve profitability, cash flow, and operational effectiveness.
* Oversee financial governance and compliance for Marquis in Canada, including application of the accounting framework applicable to statutory and consolidated reporting (ASPE and/or IFRS, as applicable), internal controls, audit requirements, and applicable federal and provincial tax obligations; coordinate with external auditors and tax advisors as appropriate.
* Provide oversight of treasury, cash flow, working capital, banking relationships, and foreign currency considerations, including intercompany balances and transactions, in partnership with the Accounting Manager and Lakeside Book Corporate Finance.
* Serve as a key finance partner in the cross\-border relationship with Lakeside Book U.S. Corporate Finance, aligning reporting, forecasting, policies, processes, and financial analysis to support consolidated business needs.
* Support Marquis integration and continuous improvement initiatives, including finance process harmonization, systems and ERP initiatives, reporting enhancements, and opportunities to strengthen efficiency, controls, and decision support across Marquis and Lakeside Book.
* Build strong relationships with operational and functional leaders, including Plant Leadership, and ensure the FP\&A Manager provides effective financial support to the Marquis Plant Finance Manager and manufacturing operations.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.


**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* 10\+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including leadership responsibility in a manufacturing, multi\-entity, or similarly complex business environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading accounting and FP\&A functions, including financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, cash flow management, and business performance analysis.
* Strong knowledge of Canadian accounting and financial reporting requirements, including the ability to interpret and apply the accounting framework relevant to the organization’s statutory and consolidated reporting.
* Working knowledge of Canadian federal and provincial tax requirements, including GST/HST and other applicable sales tax obligations, and experience partnering with external tax and audit advisors.
* Experience with multi\-entity accounting, consolidation, intercompany transactions, foreign currency considerations, and partnership with finance teams across national borders.
* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to translate complex financial and operational information into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
* Experience in manufacturing finance, including cost drivers, inventory, working capital, capital investment, and operational performance metrics.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop finance professionals and to influence stakeholders across functional and organizational boundaries.

**Brion Raffoul** is a leading IP boutique law firm in Canada, situated in Westboro, Ottawa. Our exceptional team is passionate about helping innovative companies protect their ideas, designs and brands worldwide. Our clients include domestic and multinational companies, government agencies, as well as universities.

We are seeking a **Director, Finance, HR and Operations** to join our operations on a full\-time basis. Reporting directly to the Managing Partner, the Director will be responsible for managing the full scope of the company’s financials, including the day\-to\-day accounting operations, and for leading the firm’s human resources and day\-to\-day operations. The ideal candidate will bring a positive, hands\-on approach and must be comfortable with problem\-solving and managing multiple priorities at once, holding staff accountable and following tasks through to completion without reminders. This is a terrific opportunity to take full ownership of a senior role while working directly with the Managing Partner to help shape the future of the business.

As a member of the management team, the Director will contribute to strategic planning, ensure compliance with legislative requirements, and provide leadership to staff, the Managing Partner and Management Team. The role also supervises and mentors a team of 20 to support daily operations. The Director is the first point of contact for all staff matters and manages people directly: setting clear expectations, giving timely feedback, and addressing performance and policy issues.

* Lead all HR operations for the firm’s staff, including recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management and departures.
* Own the full employee life cycle: a written training plan in place before each new hire’s first day; 30, 60 and 90\-day check\-ins; and structured departures (notices, systems access, equipment, firm announcements).
* Hold staff accountable: set clear expectations, deliver regular substantive feedback, and address performance and policy issues (including attendance and work\-from\-home policies) directly and promptly.
* Plan and maintain a firm\-wide training calendar and track completion.
* Review timesheets, expense claims and other staff submissions for completeness and accuracy before they reach the partners.
* Oversee payroll, benefits, group health insurance and RRSP programs, employment contracts and employee records.
* Onboard contractors and outsourced staff, confirming equipment, systems access, confidentiality agreements and schedules in writing before the start date.
* Maintain HR policies and the employee handbook, and advise leadership on employment standards, health and safety, human rights and other legislative compliance.
* Promote a respectful, equitable, and inclusive workplace culture.

*Financial Management \& Accounting*

* Lead all financial operations, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and compliance with GAAP.
* Oversee accounts payable/receivable, payroll, and general ledger functions.
* Prepare, and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports.
* Review all reports and calculations for accuracy and completeness before distribution.
* Work with the IP Manager and administrative staff so work is invoiced at a regular cadence through the month, avoiding month\-end backlogs.
* Manage cash flow, banking relationships, and investments.
* Coordinate the annual audit and liaise with auditors and the Financial Institutions.
* Complete all statutory filings, including CRA returns, HST, EHT and payroll remittances.
* Maintain and strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and procedures.

*Budgeting \& Financial Planning*

* Develop and implement facilities and operational continuity policies.
